description: ECS Milestone Trend for Power BI Track how milestone completion dates change across reporting periods with professional trend visualization. Key Features Trend Analysis Visualize milestone forecast evolution over time Compare current forecasts against baseline dates Automatic variance calculation and color coding Identify slipping or improving milestones at a glance Data Integration Works seamlessly with project data from: Primavera P6 (Oracle) Microsoft Project Asta Powerproject Excel/CSV exports ECS Platform (recommended for automated data extraction) Professional Visualization Multiple marker shapes (Circle, Square, Diamond, Triangle) Flexible trend lines (smooth curves, linear, or step) Comprehensive formatting controls 8 legend position options Data labels with dates and variance Grid lines and customizable axes Business Value Identify schedule trends early Improve forecast accuracy Track milestone stability over time Professional presentation quality Reduce manual trend analysis time Data Requirements Required Fields: Milestone names or identifiers (Category) Data Date labels - reporting period names (Category) Forecast Date - milestone completion dates (Measure) Optional Fields: Data Date - actual reporting dates for timeline spacing (Category) Baseline Date - original planned dates for variance (Measure) Recommended Data Source The ECS Platform (https://www.ecs.app)…
